# Mimejutsu
A technique only practiced by the most robust of mimes.
## Special abilities
None
## Combo attacks
### Mimechucks
Hits the target with an invisible pair of nunchucks, dealing some stamina damage. Will fail if the target is stunned.
### Smoke Bomb
Creates smoke on and around your target, lasting 5 seconds.
### Silent Palm
Throws the target up to 200 tiles away with only a slight touch. Will fail if the target is stunned.
